text.description_html:
Acorn AZC210, Stainless Steel Integrity Cabinet Pull

Uniquely shaped, this Acorn Stainless steel cabinet pull is an excellent way to add a modern design aesthetic to your home without leaning towards the sterility that some contemporary decor has. In fact, there is nothing boring about this cabinet pull. Crafted out of stainless steel, it straddles the barrier between art and functionality wonderfully. It is the perfect way to add points of interest to your home while proving form and function can be one and the same. Available in polished or brushed stainless steel finishes in three sizes: 3 inches, 3-1/2 inches, and 4 inches.

Also Available: Integrity Stainless Steel Knob

Specifications for the Acorn AZC210 Absolute Zero Collection Integrity Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Width: 1"
  • Projection: 1-1/4"
  • Available in polished or brushed stainless steel.

Available Sizes:

    AZC210-3
    • Length (c.c. hole spacing): 3"
    • Overall Length: 4.5"

    AZC210-3.5
    • Length (c.c. hole spacing): 3.5"
    • Overall Length: 5"

    AZC210-4
    • Length (c.c. hole spacing): 4"
    • Overall Length: 5.5"

Sold Individually
